title: Registry hardening: feature validation, visible skip report, fail-closed tracked set, checked dest archive
action: Review B-P2-2 + B-P2-7 + D-P2-1 + D-P3-1 + D-P3-2, all registry-cluster. (1) worktree register validates --feature with the same feature_slug_ok create.rs uses — non-slug refused naming the value, BEFORE any path join. (2) worktree new surfaces the cellsSync skip: handlers.rs's result map carries the bootstrap map's cellsSync when present and the text gains the same one-line skip note register already prints. (3) git_tracked_cells fails CLOSED on unexpected shape: any ls-files entry that does not strip_prefix(".bee/cells/") cleanly makes the whole tracked lookup return None (prune nothing) instead of an empty set (empty set = prune everything was the dangerous branch). (4) dest_archive.join(feature) joins the symlink-checked set at the guard (delta D-P3-1). (5) The bootstrap map gains a pruned list (file names) when the prune removed anything; the text mentions the count. (6) The fail-safe test gets a GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES-style scoped guard like close.rs's GitCeilingGuard (reuse or lift into a shared test helper). (7) close.rs fixture: seed commit passes --no-gpg-sign instead of relying on repo config (delta D-P3-2). TDD red-first where behavior changes; all existing worktree and close tests stay green.

truths: register refuses a non-slug feature before any path join
worktree new's text and JSON carry the cellsSync skip when it fires
an unparseable ls-files line means prune-nothing, never prune-everything
a symlinked dest archive dir refuses the sync like the other checked paths

artifacts.substantive: validation, fail-closed guard, checked dest archive, prune reporting, plus tests

trace.outcome: register validates feature slug pre-join; worktree new surfaces cellsSync skip; tracked-set parse fails closed; dest archive in symlink-checked set; pruned names reported; ceiling guard on fail-safe test; fixture seeds --no-gpg-sign
